title: decision(components): Door 2 — the eager `icons` record carries 1,767 lucide modules (~1.4 MB raw) into `ui-components`, and that is where the bytes are
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) on ruling **C** of objectui#9204, which triage pre-authorised: *"If Door 1 proves insufficient, Door 2 comes back as a decision card."* ⛔ Unassigned; grading and `pm:*` are triage's.

## Why this exists

objectui#9204 (Door 1 — defer lucide's dynamic-import map) was implemented end-to-end and **measured NET NEGATIVE**: `ui-components` **395,026 → 395,949 gz (+923)** on `origin/main` `91facaef6`, four full console builds in one container, with a control leg restoring the four import sites that **reproduced the baseline to the byte**.

⭐ That work's real product is the measurement that identifies where the bytes actually are, and it is not where the card looked:

> The eager lucide cost is **not the map**. The `icons` record pulls **1,767 icon modules — about 1.4 MB raw — into `ui-components`**, and those modules already carry every icon NAME as a string (`W("air-vent", node)` in the emitted chunk). That is what makes lucide's dynamic-import map nearly free in context, and a separate name list expensive.

Door 1's entire ceiling is **8,253 B against that ~1.4 MB record**. Wrong lever.

## The state this leaves

⚠️ `ui-components` has **590 bytes** of runway before the allowance ratchet fires, and the row tightened **323 bytes in 31 hours**. It is the only entry in `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES` (4,289, payable **DOWN only**), and the gate prints its own trip point: **`reds below 3378 bytes`**. objectui#9204's triage armed an escalation on it — *the ratchet actually tripping ⇒ p1*. **That trigger is still armed and now un-mitigated.**

## ⛔ One shape that is NOT the answer, recorded so nobody rediscovers it as a fix

A `vendor-icons-*` `advancedChunks` group matching lucide's per-icon modules would move ~1.4 MB raw out of `ui-components` and drop the row well under its ceiling **without removing one byte from the page load**. The console config forbids exactly this, in its own words:

> This moves NO MODULE BYTES … Nothing here may be read as headroom that was earned.

⇒ ⛔ a regrouping that satisfies the gate without shrinking the payload is gaming the instrument, not paying the debt.

## The decision this card is for

**Should the `icons` record stop being eager, and if so what replaces it at each read site?** ⛔ The dispatching seat does not decide this: the record is a published surface with censused read sites (`check-lucide-icon-record-names.mjs` exists precisely to police which names reach it), so narrowing or deferring it changes what renders.

⚠️ Interaction to price in, not discover later: objectui#9204's rescue option **A** (source `isLucideIconName`'s membership from `Object.keys(icons)`) would make `lazy-icon` **depend on this record staying eager** — so A and this card can contradict each other. Whoever rules one should rule both, or state the ordering.

## ⚠️ What has NOT been measured

No Door 2 implementation has been attempted or costed. The 1.4 MB figure is read off the emitted chunk, not off a proposed alternative. ⇒ the taker measures before proposing, and ⛔ does not inherit objectui#9204's numbers, which were taken on `91facaef6` and will have moved.

## Dedup

⚠️ No duplicate sweep with a lit control was run — REST `/search/*` answers 403 for this session by design ⇒ there is **no** "no duplicate found" assertion here. Known adjacent: objectui#9204 (Door 1, ruled C) · objectui#7848 (the measurement round that filed Door 1) · PR objectui#9250 (Door 1's measurement of record, open and deliberately unarmed).
